_README: Structured data for the NOVRA Intelligence site. Three graphs: WebSite, Person, Article.
NO Organization node is emitted, and none may be added until a legal entity
exists and its exact registered name is supplied. NOVRA Intelligence is currently a
masthead — a publication name — not a company. Emitting Organization schema
would assert to search engines that a legal organization exists, which would
be a false machine-readable claim and is explicitly out of scope.
WebSite.name carries the masthead. Person carries the real author. Article
author points at the Person, never at the masthead. That is what lets the
brand front the site while the authority accrues to a real, named human.
Every PLACEHOLDER is unverified and must be filled from fact or deleted.
A deleted field costs nothing. A false one is the whole liability.

website.name: NOVRA Intelligence
website.description: Research and perspectives on artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, blockchain infrastructure, financial technology, and emerging digital systems.

_publisher_note: publisher points at the Person, not an Organization. This is accurate: the
publication is currently published by an individual. schema.org permits a
Person as publisher and it is the honest mapping of the real arrangement.

person.name: Fredrick Mendez
person.description: Technology executive and strategist focused on artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, blockchain technology, smart contracts, software architecture, and next-generation digital infrastructure.

_person_notes: jobTitle omitted - the headline is a self-description, not a verified title.
worksFor omitted. Would require an Organization node, and BUILDFLOW_PUBLIC_DISCLOSURE=false.
alumniOf, award, hasCredential all omitted: nothing verified.
sameAs REMOVED entirely rather than shipped with a placeholder. A sameAs array
containing a guess is worse than no sameAs at all - it tells search engines to
consolidate an entity with a profile that may belong to someone else. Re-add only
after a specific URL is confirmed to resolve publicly and be controlled by the subject.
email added 2026-09-01: contact@novraintelligence.com, the single canonical public address. A role address on the owned domain, not a personal mailbox.
_copy_rules: First person singular throughout. No 'we', 'our team', 'our research'.
Those imply staff who do not exist, which is the same false claim as
Organization schema, just in prose where it is harder to audit.
No counters for papers, projects, systems, clients or years.
The word 'Research' as a section label is fine; 'Research Papers: 87' is not.
_article_url_note: The earlier template guessed https://novraintelligence.com/insights/{slug}/. That is not the
permalink structure this site uses. The one published article confirms the real pattern:
mainEntityOfPage is therefore filled from the 'link' field of the posts.create response at
publish time, never predicted. /insights/ is the index page, not an article namespace.

articles.headline: Why Agentic AI Systems Fail at Scale: A Reliability Budget
articles.description: A 99%-reliable step sounds excellent until you chain fifty of them. How to budget reliability across an agentic system instead of tuning prompts.

articles.headline: Context Engineering Is Becoming the Operating System for Production AI
articles.description: Model choice is no longer the main variable in production AI. The decisive layer is the context system — what the model is shown, from where, under whose authority, and for how long.

articles.headline: When AI Meets Smart Contracts: Designing Deterministic Boundaries for Probabilistic Systems
articles.description: AI systems reason probabilistically; smart contracts execute deterministically. The strongest architectures use that difference on purpose, putting authorization and settlement behind deterministic control.

articles.headline: Human Oversight Fails When It Is Designed as a Button
articles.description: Human-in-the-loop appears in contracts and regulation as though it were a control. Most implementations cannot function. Oversight is an architecture with a latency budget, not an approval step.

articles.headline: From AI Prototype to Production System: The Architecture of Recoverability
articles.description: A production AI system is not one that avoids failure. It is one whose failures are bounded, observable and recoverable. What that requires, concretely, at the architecture level.

_articles_note: Each entry inherits author, publisher, isPartOf and @type from article_template.
author and publisher both resolve to the Person node. No Organization node is emitted:
NOVRA AI is not a registered legal entity, and claiming one in schema is a factual claim
about the world, not a formatting choice.
image is a repo path until the asset is uploaded, then the Media Library URL.
